tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: App ground behind every screen. Only `ink` text sits directly on it or on the glow (7.2:1 worst case); never `ink-muted` or `accent` text.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Faint 32px grid drawn on `backdrop`. Texture only; invisible in the high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, the main wash behind the top of the screen. Set by the colour palette (Meadow green by default). Always blurred 64px so it has no edge; never a visible shape. Contrast figures are measured against the strongest glow of every palette at full strength.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, lower area. Set by the colour palette (Meadow yellow). Blurred wash only.

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, light relief between the other two. Set by the colour palette (Meadow cream). Blurred wash only.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default frosted tile: rows, cards, fields. Always with `blur-glass`, the `glass-sheen` bevel, a `glass-edge` rim and `shadow-glass`. Do not lower the alpha: text contrast depends on it.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Raised frosted tile: Next up card, sheets, tab bar, toast.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top-left light on a tile: a 145 degree gradient from this colour to nothing by 45%. It is what makes a pane read as a moulded tile instead of a flat tint.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim on every glass tile. Solid 3:1 border in the high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind the Quick add sheet and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Replaces `glass` when Reduce transparency is on (system or in-app).

tokens.name: surface-solid-raised
tokens.usage: Replaces `glass-raised` when Reduce transparency is on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `glass`, `glass-raised`, both solid surfaces and bare `backdrop`. On glass over any palette: 12.8:1 worst case Light, 10.7:1 Dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (cues, meta, captions) on `glass`, `glass-raised` and solid surfaces only: 5.7:1 worst case in Light and Dark over any palette. Never on bare `backdrop` or glow.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent, set by the colour palette (Meadow green by default): done beats, checked controls, primary button fill, active tab, links. As text on glass 5.1:1 Light, 6.6:1 Dark in the weakest palette. One accent-filled action per screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: 6.3:1 Light, 8.8:1 Dark in the weakest palette.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected chip or a minimum-version day. Text on it is `ink`, never `accent`.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Border of unchecked checks, toggles off, the missed-day dot and input outlines: 3.6:1 worst case on Light glass, 3.8:1 on Dark.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside one glass card. Decorative; carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty beat segments, slider and segmented-control tracks, tag fill.

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: Rest-day ring and label, a warm clay so it never looks like the green accent. 5.4:1 on Light glass, 7.2:1 on Dark over any palette. Always a ring shape, so it never depends on hue.

tokens.name: rest-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a rest-day cell in the consistency grid.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (Delete habit, Erase data), always with a word. 5.4:1 on Light glass, 5.9:1 Dark over any palette. Never used for a missed day.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard and switch-control focus ring, 2px offset. At least 6.8:1 on every surface including the glow.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one day-progress number on Today, and the streak count on Habit detail.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title, one per screen, on bare backdrop in `ink`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Next up title, sheet title, note title in the editor.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles (habit, task, note, settings), button labels.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Cue and minimum lines, task meta, note preview. `ink-muted` on glass.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, timestamps, helper text, tab labels. Smallest size for running text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels only (NEXT UP, weekday initials). Never a sentence.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between beat segments; icon to label inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a group; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Check to text; inner gaps in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin; Next up card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target, both axes.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, task check, grid cells.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Rows, note cards, settings groups.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Next up card, Quick add sheet top corners, phone-scale panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tab bar, chips, toast, toggles, habit check, beat segments.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Tiles on `glass`. Three inset layers make the moulded bevel: lit top edge, soft top glow, shaded bottom lip.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating tiles: tab bar, sheet, toast, Next up card. Same bevel, deeper drop.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Under the centre add button and the primary button only. Tinted by the colour palette.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Toggle knob, slider thumb, segmented thumb.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for `glass`. Pair with saturate(160%). Set to 0 when Reduce transparency is on.

tokens.name: blur-float
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for floating layers on `glass-raised`.

tokens.name: blur-glow
tokens.usage: Blur on every backdrop glow, so no glow ever has a visible outline.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Touch-down scale and tint. Must start on touch-down, not touch-up.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Check fill, toggle, chip select, colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Beat segment fill, row collapse after completion, toast in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Screen-to-detail transition, Next up card swap.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Quick add sheet rise. Exit runs at 75% of this.

tokens.name: duration-celebrate
tokens.usage: Day-complete bar sweep, once per day at most.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering or responding to touch.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Anything leaving the screen.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move from one place to another and stay (segmented thumb, tab indicator).

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Soft 6% overshoot for the check mark and a filling beat only. Replaced by `ease-out` at Motion: Subtle.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Rows, cards and buttons while pressed.

tokens.name: press-scale-small
tokens.usage: Checks, icon buttons and the add button while pressed.

tokens.name: motion-off
tokens.usage: Motion setting Off: no movement, 120ms cross-fades only.

tokens.name: motion-subtle
tokens.usage: Motion setting Subtle: multiplies travel distances; overshoot removed.

tokens.name: motion-standard
tokens.usage: Motion setting Standard (default).

tokens.name: motion-expressive
tokens.usage: Motion setting Expressive: multiplies travel and adds 15% to durations.

tokens.name: haptic-tick
tokens.usage: Selection tick: chip, segmented control, slider detent, tab change. iOS selection / Android CLOCK_TICK.

tokens.name: haptic-light
tokens.usage: Touch-down on a check or the add button. iOS impact light / Android VIRTUAL_KEY.

tokens.name: haptic-medium
tokens.usage: A beat completes. iOS impact medium / Android CONFIRM.

tokens.name: haptic-success
tokens.usage: All beats done for the day: two pulses 90ms apart. iOS notification success.

tokens.name: haptic-warning
tokens.usage: Destructive confirm appears. iOS notification warning / Android REJECT.

tokens.name: haptics-off
tokens.usage: Haptics setting Off: amplitude multiplier.

tokens.name: haptics-soft
tokens.usage: Haptics setting Soft.

tokens.name: haptics-balanced
tokens.usage: Haptics setting Balanced (default).

tokens.name: haptics-firm
tokens.usage: Haptics setting Firm.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon box; 1.75px stroke.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Visible check inside its 48px target.
